Minor update. Added copyright and licensing notice.

Version 1.0.0 — Initial release of "competitive-landscape" skill for technology sector analysis.

- Provides structured, evidence-driven competitive landscape reports, including player tiering, route differentiation, and white-space identification.
- Designed for requests involving multi-player mapping, sector competitor analysis, and technology domain assessments.
- Implements a tiered research workflow with explicit tool detection and fallback logic (patent/paper retrieval, web research, generic web tools, LLM-only).
- Outputs a structured Markdown report and traceable documentation files by default.
- Clearly defines appropriate use cases and redirects out-of-scope requests (e.g., single company, legal opinions) to other specialized skills.
